description: Defines the 'Networks' class and related nested classes for managing broadcast network scanning, parsing, and data handling in a DVB context within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: Networks
classes.description: Manages DVB network scanning, parsing, and storage, including handling tuner notifications and network data.

classes.name: Networks::Network
classes.description: Represents a DVB network with properties like network IDs, frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and name.

classes.name: Networks::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Networks::Parser
classes.description: Handles parsing DVB Network Information Tables (NIT) sections and manages filtering of sections.

methods.name: Networks::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for networks.

methods.name: Networks::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a network by its ID.

methods.name: Networks::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the stored networks.

methods.name: Networks::Load
methods.description: Loads network data from a DVB NIT table.
